name: Mid-term Term-Defined proration (fractional PTC)
expected: A mid-term TermDefined Anniversary line (EffectiveFrom mid-year, SubscriptionTerm annual) derives a FRACTIONAL PricingTermCount (e.g. 0.74 for ~270/365 days) AND prices the net PROPORTIONALLY: NetTotalPrice = NetUnitPrice x Quantity x PricingTermCount. A 6/12-term sale should be charged ~half the annual amount.
actual: V21 derives the fractional PTC correctly but does NOT apply it to the price — the net comes out at the FULL annual amount. Fresh Force-reprice under active V21 (isSuccess=true) of two real UI-built TermDefined Anniversary mid-term lines: (1) line 0QLWC000002LCwH4AW (Unlimited Classification, Start 2026-04-06 / End 2026-12-31 = 270 days, SubTerm=1, PB=Anniversary, Qty=3, List=250): PricingTermCount = 0.7397260273972603 (=270/365, EXACT) but NetTotalPrice = 750.00 = 250x3x1.0 (NOT prorated). Expected prorated = 250x3x0.7397 = 554.79; that 554.79 was the line's PRIOR value before this reprice. (2) line 0QLWC000002SYdV4AW (Start 2026-04-15 / End 2027-03-31 = 351 days, SubTerm=1, Qty=1, List=250): PTC = 0.9616438356164384 (=351/365, EXACT) but NetTotalPrice = 250.00 (full), prior value was 240.41 = 250x0.9616 (prorated). Full-term positive control 0QLWC000003kaUz4AI (PTC=1, List=5900) reprices to NetTotal=5900 — unaffected (x1.0). Two pre-V21 lines (LastMod 2026-05-07) on the same shape stay PRORATED (0QLWC0000034VY94AM PTC=0.9151, List=3465, NetTotal=3170.71=3465x0.9151) — proving the net WAS prorated under the earlier version and V21 dropped it.

Defect lines: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000002LCwH4AW/view (PTC=0.7397, NetTotal 750 vs expected 554.79) ; https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000002SYdV4AW/view (PTC=0.9616, NetTotal 250 vs expected 240.41). Pre-V21 prorated proof line https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC0000034VY94AM/view (NetTotal 3170.71=3465x0.9151). Full-term control https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kaUz4AI/view (PTC=1 net 5900 OK). V21 active = ESDV 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY (ExpressionSetDefinition 9QAWC0000003mg14AA, VersionNumber 21, Status Active). Proc body scan (V16 carried forward): PricingTermCount appears as a value only inside Proration / PTC-constant writers (lines 394/516/4025/4753/4911 of Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_V160.expressionSetVersion); NO Quantity*Price / Total / NetTotal step multiplies the price by PricingTermCount or ProrationMultiplier.
defectStep: Step 97/123 'Proration' (actionType=Proration; EffectiveFrom->itemTransientEndDate->ProrationMultiplier->PricingTermCount) correctly derives the fractional multiplier, but NO downstream Quantity*Price / Subscription/Software/Services Aggregate / Total Amount step (skeleton steps 98-99 'Quantity * Price', 103-118 Aggregate/Total*) consumes PricingTermCount as a price multiplier. The net-proration leg of the TermDefined proration cluster was not restored alongside the SC-3420 PTC-writer restore.
proposedFix: (described, NOT applied) Restore the net-proration leg removed in the V11->V12 term-derivation rebuild: multiply the term-priced net by PricingTermCount before/within the Quantity*Price -> Total aggregation for TermDefined lines (e.g. a TermDefined-gated FormulaBasedPricing/AssignmentElement that sets NetTotalPrice = NetUnitPrice x Quantity x PricingTermCount, mirroring native RLM term-price behaviour). Guard identically to the PTC writer (SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND ItemSubscriptionTerm IsNotNull) so full-term (PTC=1) and PB-null lines are inert. Validate by re-repricing 0QLWC000002LCwH4AW back to NetTotal 554.79 and 0QLWC000002SYdV4AW to 240.41. Owner-gated (Marc/Nir co-own the proc); ship only after a draft-version test since the cluster churns.
regression: SC-3420 / SC-3411 (same V11->V12 TermDefined proration-cluster rebuild by Nir Kailash 2026-06-11 that dropped the TermDefined Proration steps; SC-3420 restored the PTC *derivation* writer into V16->V21 but the net-*proration* leg was not restored)
notes: Preflight PASS: real UI-built (not headless Apex-inserted) TermDefined Anniversary lines; PBE active in Fortra Price Book, USD, list>0; SellingModelType=TermDefined, Fortra_Product_Type__c=Subscription; the proration branch demonstrably FIRED (PTC went fractional, day-count/365 exact to 1e-9), so this is NOT the headless base-seed $0 artifact and NOT a route/data error. Two independent controls reproduce; full-term control (PTC=1) unaffected; pre-V21-era lines on identical shape remain prorated, isolating the change to V21. The fractional-PTC DERIVATION half of the scenario PASSES (SC-3420 fix live, confirmed by I-01/I-02); only the NET-PRORATION half fails. Real-world impact: a mid-term sale / 6-months-into-12 add-seats is charged the FULL annual amount instead of the prorated fraction (over-charge). Survey: of 4 live Anniversary fractional-PTC qty>0/list>0 lines, the 2 repriced today under V21 = NOT prorated, the 2 last priced 2026-05-07 = prorated. PricingTermCount is platform read-only so this cannot be patched at flow/Apex tier; fix must be in the procedure. No deploys/edits made — validation only.
verdict_reason: Active V21 derives the correct fractional PricingTermCount (0.7397, 0.9616 = day-count/365) but the net is computed at full annual (NetTotal=list x qty, not x PTC), so a mid-term TermDefined sale is over-charged — the net-proration leg of the proration cluster is missing while the PTC-writer leg is present.
